subject: ReqPack: security control annotated response and evidence assembly
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@sentinelbridge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: ReqPack_v2 — annotated control mapping and evidence ask

Hi Laura / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Attached is our latest ReqPack (ReqPack_v2.zip) — it contains the control list we need mapping for (SOC 2 + ISO 27001 + SIG subset) along with column headers for evidence pointers.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood provide an annotated control mapping (which Redwood control maps to our ReqPack control ID) and an initial list of artifacts for each control?
- For technical controls we need either evidence files (log snippets, config exports) or a clear playbook describing how to reproduce/verify.
- For policy/process controls we need named owners, dates of last review, and a pointer to the formal artifact (Doc ID or file).

Ideal timeline: initial annotated mapping by end of day Aug 16, handoff of sample artifacts by Aug 18. We recognize some items need legal or redaction steps — flag those up front.

I'm copying ProcureOps for visibility. If you prefer, we can do a short 30-minute handoff call tomorrow.

Attachments: [ReqPack_v2.zip (contains: controls.csv, questions.md)]

Best,
Alex Cho
Procurement Lead | SentinelBridge
alex.cho@sentinelbridge.com
+1 415-555-0136

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@sentinelbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReqPack_v2 — annotated control mapping and evidence ask

Alex — thanks for the ReqPack. We reviewed the CSV and have sketched a delivery approach.

Plan of record:
1) Deliver a first-pass annotated mapping (SOC2/ISO/SIG columns filled) by EOD Aug 16. This will be an "annotated" spreadsheet that points to Redwood control IDs and a short description of the artifact type (e.g., "config export", "policy document", "telemetry sample").
2) Deliver a companion evidence manifest (CSV) with sample artifact filenames and custody notes by Aug 18.
3) For any items requiring legal review or redaction we will mark the evidence row with a Redaction Needed flag and propose redaction steps.

Ownership: Kimberly (cc'd) will own evidence collection and privacy/redaction questions; Karthik (will follow with a technical evidence packet for telemetry, logs, and infra config). I will own project coordination and the annotated spreadsheet.

I've attached the annotated template we plan to use so you can see the columns and expected artifact naming. If that structure works we will populate it directly with links to artifacts or stub filenames.

Attachments: [Redwood_ReqPack_annotated.xlsx (template), evidence_manifest_template.csv]

Would you like a quick call tomorrow at 9am PT to walk the columns? If so, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Assurance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — making inference predictable and economical

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@sentinelbridge.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-16T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReqPack_v2 — annotated control mapping and evidence ask

On Thu, Aug 15, 2028 at 10:05 AM laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
> I've attached the annotated template we plan to use so you can see the columns and expected artifact naming.

Alex / Laura — quick clarifying questions from the evidence side:
- For telemetry/logs: do you need raw log exports or redacted samples (we can provide both, but raw exports require an NDA addendum for some customers)?
- For customer-data related controls (data residency / deletion traces) — do you want event-level samples or a summarized runbook + query that demonstrates the deletion workflow?
- For SIG-specific vendor-security items where the question is "who performs the review" — we will name the role (e.g., Platform Reliability Manager) and provide the last review date.

If you can confirm the artifact format preferences (raw vs redacted vs runbook) we'll stage the manifest accordingly.

Thanks — I'll start pulling the policy docs and a first batch of policy evidence (signed policies, last review dates) and upload to the shared Drive folder.

Kimberly Park
Senior Assurance Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@sentinelbridge.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-17T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReqPack_v2 — annotated control mapping and evidence ask

Alex / Laura / Kim — attaching the technical sample bundle and a short mapping note. Highlights:
- Telemetry: provided a compressed snapshot (telemetry_snapshot_20280815.tar.gz) containing anonymized request traces for a 24-hour window, plus a README that lists the log fields and masking applied.
- KMS/provable keys: included key rotation summary and the KMS audit export (redacted key IDs).
- Runtime config: included example inference service config (production) and the kernel selection matrix referenced in control R-17.

Notes on verification: where the ReqPack asks for "evidence that continuous batching reduces tokens" we provide the benchmarking report (bench-report-202807.zip) and the production trace sample that shows batching intervals. If you need raw traces rather than the anonymized sample we will need a brief processing checklist to run before transfer.

Attachments: [telemetry_snapshot_20280815.tar.gz (anonymized logs + README), bench-report-202807.zip (PDF summary included)]

I'll update the annotated spreadsheet with links to these files in the shared Drive — same folder as your ReqPack.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
